set.body: Active direction: docs/VISION.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. Complete the pinned eyesim baseline, usable public workflows, typed persistence, independent extensions and headless application consumption, then accept/stabilize the foundation. Fixation/recording/temporal plans, descriptors, preflight, preview, repetition and training-only fixed-feature R fit are implemented. Packaged comparison and detector extension proof passed on JVM/JS; do not list the second family as missing wholesale. Public mdoc/Laika guides and CI task now exist, with local executed first-study and acquired-recording save/restore examples. Remaining: 14 classified baseline gaps, full-journey consumer/app progress/cancellation evidence, API documentation completeness and operational/supported-runtime release gates. UI-X4 and UI-S2 reviewed branches await integration with this checkout; not delivered main evidence yet. No new framework, GUI, frame4s adapter, or licensed EDF gate for pure development. Keep open.
